name: @maprama/engine-native
description: Maprama native render engine (v2): MapLibre Native patch queue + 2.5D maprama layer behind Fabric/JSI. Currently the design, the C++ core skeleton and its protocol conformance harness.

scripts.test:core: bash scripts/build-core.sh --tests && ./build/maprama_core_tests --fixtures cpp/tests/fixtures --emit build/emitted-events.jsonl && node scripts/verify-emitted-events.mjs build/emitted-events.jsonl
